decision.reason: The exact local probability cache adds three full-workgroup barriers and LDS producer/consumer traffic; duplicate wave-local softmax already overlaps across the four SIMD dimension waves, so removing redundant arithmetic does not reduce the unprofiled critical path.
decision.do_not_retry: Do not materialize an exact scalar probability tile in LDS without also changing PV to a tensorized consumer that amortizes the synchronization.
decision.next_distinct_surface: A useful Vulkan transfer must couple the probability tile to cooperative/tensorized PV or find a no-block-barrier scalar ownership change.
